attacks.claim: Migration 0148 irreversibly drops the legacy_legs column, which the 4.x orders-svc template endpoints read. Rolling orders-svc back to v4.18.2 after 0148 has run leaves those endpoints querying a column that no longer exists, so the stated 15-minute rollback to the previous version cannot succeed. This also breaks the agreed requirement that backend releases be rollback-able to the previous version within 30 minutes.
attacks.evidence: Engineering notes: "Saved templates move from `order_templates.legacy_legs` ... read by the 4.x orders-svc template endpoints". Migration 0148: "ALTER TABLE order_templates DROP COLUMN legacy_legs;". Rollback plan: "`kubectl rollout undo deploy/orders-svc` to v4.18.2 ... Migrations are forward-only; no down migrations are needed for this release."
